measurement_plan.validity: Bind original plan/decision, actor, attempt and invalidation conditions; monotonic start/end and freshness gates. No copied sample renews validity.
measurement_plan.duration: Measure before first authorized effect through protocol/readiness and governed terminal close. Separate Stop and retained-state duration; local timeouts are not a global bound.
measurement_plan.freshness: Record collection start/end, observation age and identity invalidation at effects, receive, close and readiness; preserve clock-domain provenance.
measurement_plan.resources: Per-phase pre/post baselines and retained maxima; separate managed census, physical, commit, stacks, kernel, pipe, SCM/token queries and public hash/RNG. Attribute shared ownership once, deduplicate participants by original process identity and PID/creation. UNKNOWN stays charged/denied.
measurement_plan.close: SQR1 DATA is not close. Correlate SQC1 original producer and delivered reference IDs against original destination-table evidence; independent actor receipts, outstanding I/O and retained references; no timeout-as-quiescence or retry.

justification: Only invariant byte sizes and fixed accepted handle caps are established. Models justify rejection/order, not empirical native latency or costs. No positive numeric operational policy has been derived.

progress_bounds.proof: scqt_io_result rejects zero or excess progress; each successful completion advances at least one payload byte; one submission/poll per continuation call
progress_bounds.limitations: 4252 is only the algebraic max number of positive byte-completion steps per actor in this fixed protocol. Pending polls/waits, independent acquisition, queries, scheduling and close/retention are not bounded by this count.

operational_formulas.admission_window: valid_until > valid_from; valid_from <= current_tick < valid_until at checked transitions; same live invocation and original protected plan
operational_formulas.global_duration: expiry denies further effects and requests Stop; pending native calls/IO and retained lifetime are not guaranteed to end at expiry
operational_formulas.freshness: measured collection_end - collection_start and now - collection_end must satisfy independently justified bounds and current original identity/invalidation checks; copy does not renew
operational_formulas.physical_and_commit: observed available capacity >= justified active/transient/retained/shared reservation + justified margin, separately for physical and commit; unknown material terms deny
operational_formulas.handles: guard124 and own128; administration1024 for applicable original participants, deduplicated by original process/PID-creation, including shared and retained resources; no fictitious credits

first_missing_factual_evidence: SCQ-specific justified native collection/latency/resource envelope and current original admission inputs; model constants, finite samples and compiler census cannot supply these bounds.
